I just checked teku-besu-1 and I see that we've been falling back to self building bids but not systematically.
I also see many remote bids being rejected because they don't pass the gossip validation: we've already received a bid but then we reject a new bid which value is less than 1% higher than the one we've already received (for the same slot and the same parent block hash).
The minimum increment default value is set to 1% and can be overridden using the `--Xmin-bid-increment-percentage` option.
Are you running tests by submitting new bids with higher values but not 1% more?
